settings.item_text: We do everything handcrafted, not any AI or Machine involved.
We provide 3D-design previews and open for multiple adjustments until meeting your expectation.

We’ve been doing this for years, building strong expertise through hands-on experience. With over 6,000 completed projects for customers across 10+ countries. We definitely know how to get the work done in the way you will love it!
Multiple review rounds aimed at a high-likeness result
Each portrait crafted by an artist – never mass-produced

settings.hero_subtitle: We create one-of-a-kind, handcrafted 3D-printed sculpture that preserve the once-in-a-lifetime moments between people and their loved ones.
settings.about_body:
Our journey began in 2023, when Zoe, a professional clay sculptor, discovered 3D printing technology and learned how it could be used to create realistic human models with the support of 3D sculpting tools and advanced 3D printers. What started as an experimental foundation stage quickly gained global attention, going viral within handmade-art communities and inspiring the participation of more sculptors and painting artists.

At first, we operated under the name “Ifacecustombobblehead”, which we used for about a year. However, we later shortened it to “ifaceusa” because we originally launched in the U.S. market, and we wanted to avoid confusion with traditional “bobbleheads,” which are very different from our detailed 3D-printed sculptures.

If you search "ifaceusa.com", you’ll now be redirected to "iface3d.com". This is because we recently rebranded to “IFACE3D” to reflect our growing global expansion and to better represent the true nature of our work(3D Arts). Today, our team includes talented artists from around the world.

Now, our studio specializes in full-body statues and portrait busts, crafted to the highest standard. Our mission is to create meaningful tributes that make your most treasured moments feel truly everlasting.
settings.about_tagline: IT IS MORE THAN A FIGURINE, BUT A LIFETIME KEEPSAKE!
